answer: An agent economy resists Sybil swarms by charging admission in collateral slashed on fraud. Each identity must lock copper-denominated stake and bind to one hardware root, so a farm of ten thousand pseudonyms must front ten thousand stakes, and any cluster caught sharing roots burns every bond at once. Honest agents pay nothing extra, since deposits return on exit; attackers watch locked capital melt to a black onyx. Vote weight also needs aged stake and attestations from unrelated peers, so fresh swarms hold no sway, and arbiters trace shared funding to its first ember and slash the lineage.
